params.body:
Upgrades the platform from Laravel 12 to Laravel 13, following the official upgrade guide and the `laravel/laravel` 12.x...13.x skeleton diff. Companion notes, the preview checklist and the post-deploy step are in `docs/upgrades/2026-09-18-laravel-13.md`.

## Packages

`composer update` of the bumped packages with `--with-all-dependencies` (needed once: debugbar 3.x pins `illuminate/session ^12`). Every major that changed:

| package | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| laravel/framework | 12.69.2 | 13.32.0 |
| laravel/passport | 12.4.3 | 13.8.0 |
| league/oauth2-server (via passport) | 8.5.5 | 9.4.1 |
| league/event (via passport) | 2.3.0 | 3.0.3 |
| laravel/tinker | 2.11.1 | 3.0.2 |
| mollie/laravel-mollie | 3.1.0 | 4.1.1 |
| mollie/mollie-api-php | 2.79.1 | 3.14.0 |
| elibyy/tcpdf-laravel | 11.5.0 | 13.0.1 |
| barryvdh/laravel-debugbar (dev) | 3.16.5 | 4.4.3 |
| php-debugbar/php-debugbar (dev) | 2.2.6 | 3.8.0 |
| phpunit/phpunit (dev) | 11.5.55 | 12.5.35 |
| phpunit/* and sebastian/* (dev) | 11.x line | 12.x line |
| symfony/* (console, http-foundation, http-kernel, routing, mailer, mime, process, finder, error-handler, var-dumper, uid, psr-http-message-bridge) | 7.4 | 8.1 |
| brick/math | 0.14.8 | 0.19.1 |
| guzzlehttp/uri-template | 1.0.11 | 2.0.1 |
| phpseclib/phpseclib | 3.0.55 | 4.0.1 |
| theseer/tokenizer (dev) | 1.3.1 | 2.0.1 |

Added: psr/http-server-handler, psr/http-server-middleware, symfony/polyfill-php82, symfony/polyfill-php86, php-debugbar/symfony-bridge (dev). Removed: lcobucci/clock, symfony/polyfill-php83, sebastian/code-unit, sebastian/code-unit-reverse-lookup (dev). Minor: livewire 4.4.4 to 4.4.5, carbon 3.13 to 3.14, tcpdf 6.10 to 6.11. Unchanged and 13-compatible by their own constraints: maatwebsite/excel 4.0.3, telescope 5.20, nightwatch 1.28, spatie/laravel-ignition, ably/laravel-broadcaster, collision 8.x, ide-helper 3.x, mockery 1.6.

## Code changes the guide asks for

- **CSRF middleware renamed.** `App\Http\Middleware\VerifyCsrfToken` is now `App\Http\Middleware\PreventRequestForgery` extending Laravel 13's class; Kernel, `CarpassEndpointTest`, `OutboundTest`, `SessionGuardTest` and a route comment follow. Same exception list.
- **Cache `serializable_classes`.** Set to `null` (Laravel 12 behaviour) with the reasoning in the config: some thirty call sites cache Eloquent models and collections (feature flags, StocklistBrowser/OwnStockList filter lists, Elixir's job list); a class allow-list would be long and fails silently (`__PHP_Incomplete_Class`). Tightening is a follow-up once those sites cache arrays.
- **Session `serialization` stays `php`**, now written explicitly with a comment: the skeleton's `json` would log every dealer out.
- **phpunit.xml** already matched the PHPUnit 12 schema (`--migrate-configuration` had nothing to do). No `@test` annotations in the suite. `Js::from`, pagination view names, `array_first`, `QueueBusy`, `JobAttempted`: grepped, not used.
- **Passport 13** (its own upgrade guide): `User implements OAuthenticatable`; `AccessTokenController::issueToken(ServerRequestInterface, ResponseInterface): Response`; Kernel alias `client` to `CheckToken`; removed keys `client_uuids` and `personal_access_client` dropped from `config/passport.php`. Verified against the test database that a personal access token (`createToken('api_token')`, the token dealers copy from the user screen) is still issued and authenticates `GET /api/connected` with the existing `oauth_clients` columns and a plain client secret. **After the deploy: `php artisan passport:hash` once** (irreversible; only the password grant compares secrets, see finding below).
- **Mollie v4 / SDK v3**: `methods->allActive()` to `allEnabled()` in `IntegrationChecks`; the SDK now drops a method without `status`, so the smoke-test fake carries `status: activated` like Mollie does; `ApiException` needs a `Response`, so `TransportChainTest` gets its 404 from the SDK's own fake. The package still speaks through Laravel's Http client, so the `Outbound` seal and `Outbound::impact('mollie')` are untouched.
- **Guests got an empty 401 instead of the login page.** Undocumented in the guide: Laravel 13's exception handler no longer falls back to `route('login')` when the auth middleware names no redirect. The Kernel pointed `auth` at the framework `Authenticate`; it now points at `App\Http\Middleware\Authenticate`, which already existed and returns `route('login')`. Caught by `InsightsTest` and `TransportChainTest`.
- **PHPUnit 12.3.4+**: `HandleExceptions::flushState()` needs the running test, otherwise it takes PHPUnit's own error handler down and every later test is reported risky (305 of them in the first run). `SmokeTest` passes `$this` where it boots a second application.

## CSRF origin check: what Laravel 13 actually does

Read from `vendor/laravel/framework/src/Illuminate/Foundation/Http/Middleware/PreventRequestForgery.php`: the request passes when it is a read, or on the `except` list, or `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin`, or the session token matches. The header only **adds** a way through; `same-site` counts only with `allowSameSite()`, and a refusal on the header alone happens only in `useOriginOnly()` mode, which is off. So nothing that passed on Laravel 12 is refused now.

Decision per route, pinned in the new `tests/Feature/RequestForgeryTest.php` (runs the middleware with its phpunit bypass switched off, like `SessionGuardTest`):

| route | decision | why |
|---|---|---|
| `website/*` (contact form posted from a dealer's own domain, `routes/_partials/Website.php`) | exception, unchanged | the dealer's page cannot carry our session token; test: cross-site POST without token reaches the handler, also without the header (old browsers) |
| `mollie/webhook`, `blurit/status`, `whatsapp` | exception, unchanged | third parties calling us; test: cross-site POST passes |
| `webhook/*` (`routes/webhooks.php`, Hexon/Okasie image callbacks) and `api/*` (Passport, stateless) | no exception needed | not in the `web` group; test asserts the middleware is not in their resolved stack |
| Livewire update endpoint (`default-livewire.update`) | protected, unchanged | in the `web` group; the iframe is a document on our origin, so its Livewire requests are same-origin and carry the token (`SessionGuardTest`); test asserts the middleware is in the stack |
| every other form behind the login (e.g. `ownvehicle.destroy`) | protected | test: cross-site or same-site without token is refused, wrong token is refused, same-origin or a valid token passes |

No behaviour change for the iframe, so no business rule changes for it (P3-3.11 stays as is; the contact-form test carries `@rule P1-3.3`).

## Business rules

No new rules. One finding, `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-18-api-token-wachtwoordgrant-uit.md`: `POST api/token` (R P3-1.1, the OAuth password grant) has answered 400 since Passport 12, because the password grant is off by default and nothing enables it; verified on the code before and after this upgrade. The rule's source column marks `~code:AuthServiceProvider::boot` (stand `betwist`, rewritten with `bin/rules-sources --write`). Behaviour is left as it is; the partners use the token from the user screen, as `docs/api/partner-api.md` says.

## Tests

Full suite (`vendor/bin/phpunit`, own MySQL database from the schema dump plus migrations, `npm run build` in the worktree first): `Tests: 1700, Assertions: 9802, Failures: 1` (the one failure is `BuildStampTest`, worktree-only, below); 9 PHPUnit notices are pre-existing `createMock` calls without expectations in `ChatBotServiceTest` and `DocChatbotTest` (PHPUnit 12 reports them, not errors). Failures understood and fixed as above; `BuildStampTest` needs the checkout's `.git` refs and fails in a git worktree only (it reads `.git/HEAD` through `gitdir:`; on Forge and CI the checkout is a clone).

## Docs

`CLAUDE.md` and `README.md` say Laravel 13 / PHPUnit 12; `docs/upgrades/2026-09-18-laravel-13.md` has what changed, the preview checklist (login and guest redirect, iframe contact form from a dealer domain, Livewire in the iframe, webhooks Hexon/Okasie/Blurit, Mollie checkout if the test key is on, partner API, a PDF) and the `.env` note: nothing to add; `SESSION_COOKIE` is explicit on production and preview and `config/session.php` has its own `<app>_session` fallback, so the cookie name does not change and nobody is logged out; `PASSPORT_PERSONAL_ACCESS_CLIENT_*` are no longer read.
